content.title:
Scored quiz
Module 7
content.intro: This quiz covers all the lessons in this module. You must achieve 80% to pass. Good luck!

questions.prompt: A Ministry of Energy seeks to optimize off-grid investments in underserved rural zones but has limited household-level data. Which of the following techniques could most effectively identify priority areas for electrification?

options.value: Cost–Benefit Analysis using national grid maps
Supervised Machine Learning using labeled access data and satellite imagery

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Supervised ML trained on remote sensing and labeled access data can estimate electrification status and prioritize interventions.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Supervised ML trained on remote sensing and labeled access data can estimate electrification status and prioritize interventions.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a necessary condition for using energy data to support gender-transformative policy design?

options.value: Smart meter deployment in capital cities
Disaggregated data across gender, income, and location
Technical capacity in the private sector

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Only disaggregated data can reveal energy access inequalities and support targeted, gender-responsive policies.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Only disaggregated data can reveal energy access inequalities and support targeted, gender-responsive policies.

questions.prompt: You are supporting a PM&E strategy for a regional clean cooking program. Which of the following indicators would provide actionable insights into intersectional equity?

options.value: LPG consumption in rural vs urban areas
Time poverty burden for women in woodfuel-dependent households

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Time poverty reveals structural burdens faced by women and is critical for intersectional energy planning.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Time poverty reveals structural burdens faced by women and is critical for intersectional energy planning.

questions.prompt: Which principle of the UN Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics is most directly threatened when private smart meter data is used without clear consent or anonymization?

options.value: Principle 4: Right to comment on misinterpretation

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Using personal data without safeguards breaches professional ethics and undermines trust.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Using personal data without safeguards breaches professional ethics and undermines trust.

questions.prompt: A government wants to use machine learning to target electricity subsidies. What is a key ethical risk if training data is drawn only from urban consumers?

options.value: Overfitting the model to low-income contexts
Algorithmic bias reinforcing exclusion of rural and informal households
Model instability due to grid reliability

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Biased training data can systematically exclude underserved groups, reinforcing inequality.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Biased training data can systematically exclude underserved groups, reinforcing inequality.

questions.prompt: What is a key advantage of using prescriptive analytics over predictive analytics in energy transition planning?

options.value: It allocates capital expenditure in national budgets
It recommends specific actions based on predicted outcomes

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Prescriptive models translate predictions into concrete decision pathways for planners.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Prescriptive models translate predictions into concrete decision pathways for planners.

questions.prompt: In contexts where real-time monitoring is essential (e.g. for distributed solar networks), what architecture is most effective to reduce latency and dependence on central servers?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Edge computing allows real-time, local processing critical for adaptive energy systems.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Edge computing allows real-time, local processing critical for adaptive energy systems.

questions.prompt: A country has just adopted OSeMOSYS for long-term planning. What is its main value for policymakers?

options.value: It visualizes renewable logos for public campaigns
It enables simulation of different energy policy scenarios and investment pathways

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: OSeMOSYS models techno-economic pathways under constraints and helps test policy impacts.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: OSeMOSYS models techno-economic pathways under constraints and helps test policy impacts.

questions.prompt: In institutionalizing data governance, what is the main value of establishing a regulatory sandbox in the energy sector?

options.value: It provides a safe space to test data-driven innovation under monitored conditions

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Sandboxes let regulators and innovators co-design and test new energy data solutions before full implementation.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Sandboxes let regulators and innovators co-design and test new energy data solutions before full implementation.
